description: Return the account-level attribution overview: installs accounted-for by evidence class (verified / matched / modeled / organic), MER, revenue and data freshness.

app_id.description: Optional app id to scope the result to one app.

from.description: First UTC day of an explicit window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use instead of period; sending both is a 400.

period.description: Reporting window. Omit to use the endpoint's documented default.

to.description: Last UTC day of an explicit window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use instead of period; sending both is a 400.

name: get_attribution_rollup
title: Get attribution rollup
